text: Codex review accepts Slice 757 only as an isolated candidate. Solid control grouping is useful; translucency adds no meaningful value in the real normal-flow inspection layout. Focused coverage/build/type/rendered gates passed. Full repository coverage had three failures under parallel workers; all three passed in isolation, but global coverage is not certified. No merge/deployment until full gate is green; parent UIQ-08 remains Backlog and production integration needs separate maintainer admission.
